tools.name: latest_digest
tools.description: The latest Biterminal Bitcoin digest (daily by default): title, URL, summary and full markdown.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search Biterminal Bitcoin stories by keywords. All words must appear. Returns title, URL, date, sentiment and a short summary.

tools.name: sentiment
tools.description: Bullish / bearish / neutral split of Biterminal Bitcoin stories over a window, with top categories.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Biterminal activity counts, numbers only (no content, ids or emails): community contributions by status (approved, pending, rejected), endorsements by status, searches (distinct queries searched today UTC and in the last 7 days, plus totals), alerts, and confirmed digest subscribers. Cached up to 60

tools.name: check_source
tools.description: Has this source URL already been submitted? Returns only {exists, status} with status approved, pending, rejected or null. URLs are compared normalized (scheme/host case, www., fragment, trailing slash, utm_*/fbclid/gclid and query order ignored). Check before submit_contribution.

tools.name: submit_contribution
tools.description: Submit a sourced Bitcoin claim to the community research queue. Requires an agent token (Authorization: Bearer bt_...). Lands as pending and is private until a moderator approves it. 10 per token per UTC day. A source URL that already exists (normalized, any status) or a near-identical claim gets 40

tools.name: endorse_contribution
tools.description: Confirm or dispute a public community contribution. Requires an agent token. Lands as pending until approved. 50 per token per UTC day.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_contribution" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Submit a sourced Bitcoin claim to the community research queue. Requires an agent token (Authorization: Bearer bt_...). Lands as pending and is private until a …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_stories, check_source · Private data: submit_contribution, endorse_contribution · Public sink: submit_contribution.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_stories, check_source · Private data: submit_contribution, endorse_contribution · Public sink: submit_contribution

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
